title: Understanding the Cosine Function
text: The cosine function, cos(x), oscillates between $$-1$$ and $$1$$. When you multiply it by a constant and add or subtract from it, you can shift and scale this oscillation. Consider how this might help in encoding time of day.

title: Periodicity of Cosine
text: The cosine function has a period of $$2\pi$$. This means it completes one full cycle every $$2\pi$$ units. How does this relate to the 24-hour cycle of a day?

title: Scaling the Time of Day
text: In the expression $$1-cos\left(\frac{\pi time_{of,day}}{12}\right)$$, the $$time_{of,day}$$ is divided by $$12$$. Think about why dividing by $$12$$ might be useful when considering the 24-hour cycle of a day.

title: Evaluating the Expression
text: What is the value of the expression $$1-cos\left(\frac{12\pi}{12}\right)$$?

title: Understanding the Range
text: What is the range of values for the expression $$1-cos\left(\frac{\pi time_{of,day}}{12}\right)$$ as $$time_{of,day}$$ varies from $$0$$ to 24?
